# IdeDocumentMounting

`Flare.Components.IDE.IdeDocumentMounting`

How FlareIdeLayout mounts the content of docked documents.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `All` | `0` | Every document in Documents invokes its content and stays mounted while it exists, hidden when inactive. State is preserved at one component instance per document. |
| `ActiveOnly` | `1` | Only the active document of each region - plus documents retained by RetainDocumentContent - invokes its content. An inactive document's content is disposed, so its transient state is lost until it becomes active again. Keeps the cost of expensive editors proportional to the visible documents. |

## Used by components

- `FlareIdeLayout`
